name: Northern Blue-Tongued Skink
description: The Northern Blue-Tongued Skink (Tiliqua scincoides intermedia) is one of the most sought-after pet lizards in the hobby. Known for their docile temperament and striking blue tongue, these robust omnivores thrive in captivity and are an excellent choice for intermediate reptile keepers. Each animal is captive-bred and feeding on a varied diet of vegetables and insects.

name: Irian Jaya Blue-Tongued Skink
description: The Irian Jaya Blue-Tongued Skink is a stunning locality variant from the highlands of New Guinea, prized for its clean banding and smaller adult size compared to northern BTS. These captive-bred babies are established on a mixed diet and show excellent feeding responses. A great intermediate-level lizard with a famously calm disposition.

name: Crested Gecko
description: The Crested Gecko (Correlophus ciliatus) was once thought extinct and is now one of the most popular pet reptiles in the world. These captive-bred juveniles are established on Pangea fruit-mix diet and display vibrant patterning. Hardy, arboreal, and tolerant of room temperature, they are an ideal gecko for beginners and seasoned keepers alike.

name: Gargoyle Gecko
description: The Gargoyle Gecko (Rhacodactylus auriculatus) is a robust, chunky cousin of the Crested Gecko native to New Caledonia. Known for their striking bumpy skin texture and striking color variation — ranging from reds and oranges to grays and whites — these captive-bred animals are feeding well on CGD and insects. They are a fantastic intermediate gecko species.

name: Argentine Black and White Tegu
description: The Argentine Black and White Tegu (Salvator merianae) is the largest tegu species and is renowned for its dog-like intelligence and sociability. These captive-bred babies are already responding to handling and eating a varied diet of whole prey and fruits. They require a large enclosure and dedicated keeper, rewarding owners with years of personable companionship.

name: Red Tegu
description: The Red Tegu (Salvator rufescens) is a stunning South American monitor relative prized for the brilliant red and orange pigmentation that develops in adult males. These captive-bred babies are healthy, alert, and feeding well on mice and fruit. A truly impressive display animal that can become tame with consistent handling — best suited for experienced keepers.

name: Ball Python
description: The Ball Python (Python regius) is the world's most popular pet snake, beloved for its manageable size, gentle nature, and astonishing variety of color morphs. This captive-bred baby is from quality breeder stock, feeding reliably on frozen-thawed hopper mice. Ideal for first-time snake owners — they are escape-resistant, slow-moving, and long-lived.

name: Pastel Ball Python
description: The Pastel Ball Python is a co-dominant morph of Python regius displaying a washed-out golden-yellow base with bright white sides and reduced dark patterning. These captive-bred babies carry proven genetics and are eating well on frozen-thawed feeders. Pastel animals are a cornerstone of ball python breeding and a stunning conversation piece on their own.

name: Corn Snake
description: The Corn Snake (Pantherophis guttatus) is the quintessential beginner snake — slim, active, and available in a rainbow of captive-bred color morphs. This baby is established on frozen-thawed pinkies and has a fantastic feeding response. Corn snakes are escape artists, so a secure lid is essential, but their hardy constitution and curious nature make them endlessly rewarding pets.

name: Okeetee Corn Snake
description: The Okeetee Corn Snake is a classic locality variant from the Okeetee Hunt Club region of South Carolina, famous for producing animals with rich red saddles, intense orange bases, and bold black borders — widely considered the most striking wild-type corn snake pattern. This captive-bred baby is a perfect specimen for keepers who appreciate natural beauty over synthetic morphs.

name: Hognose Snake
description: The Western Hognose Snake (Heterodon nasicus) is a fan-favorite for its dramatic defensive displays — flattening its neck, hissing, and playing dead — none of which cause any real threat. These captive-bred babies have already begun eating frozen-thawed pinky mice and are available in a growing variety of captive morphs. Rear-fanged and mild-venom make them safe for experienced hobbyists.

name: Anaconda Hognose Snake
description: The Anaconda Hognose is a captive-bred morph of Heterodon nasicus characterized by reduced dorsal patterning that gives the snake a nearly patternless appearance, reminiscent of the giant constrictors. Combined with the hognose's comically dramatic bluff displays and manageable size, this morph is one of the most in-demand animals in the colubrid hobby today.

name: White's Tree Frog
description: White's Tree Frog (Litoria caerulea), also known as the Dumpy Tree Frog, is one of the most beloved amphibians in the hobby thanks to its puppy-dog eyes, chubby build, and remarkably calm temperament. These captive-bred frogs are established on gut-loaded crickets and mealworms. Hardy and long-lived, they are a fantastic first amphibian for any keeper.

name: Red-Eyed Tree Frog
description: The Red-Eyed Tree Frog (Agalychnis callidryas) is the iconic ambassador of tropical rainforests and one of the most photographed frogs on Earth. With brilliant crimson eyes, neon-green skin, and vivid blue-and-yellow flanks, these captive-bred juveniles are truly breathtaking. Best suited for intermediate keepers comfortable with a tropical bioactive vivarium setup.

name: Pacman Frog
description: The Pacman Frog (Ceratophrys ornata), or Argentine Horned Frog, is a sedentary ambush predator known for its enormous mouth relative to its round body — earning its popular name. These captive-bred juveniles are aggressive feeders eating appropriately sized crickets and small roaches. They require minimal space and are one of the most low-maintenance amphibians available.

name: Albino Pacman Frog
description: The Albino Pacman Frog is a captive-bred color morph of Ceratophrys ornata displaying a stunning yellow and orange body with red eyes — a striking contrast to the natural green form. These animals carry the same voracious feeding behavior and sedentary lifestyle as their normal-colored counterparts. A perfect eye-catching conversation piece that needs minimal space.

name: Axolotl
description: The Axolotl (Ambystoma mexicanum) is a fully aquatic neotenic salamander native to Mexico City's lake system, now critically endangered in the wild but thriving in captivity. Famous for their feathery external gills and permanently juvenile appearance, axolotls are extraordinary animals capable of regenerating limbs and organs. These captive-bred animals are healthy and eating pellets and bloodworms.

name: Chaco Golden Knee Tarantula
description: The Chaco Golden Knee Tarantula (Grammostola pulchripes) is widely regarded as the best beginner tarantula in the hobby — slow-moving, extremely docile, and strikingly beautiful with its golden-yellow leg striping on a velvet-black body. These captive-bred juveniles are already established in their growth and feeding well on appropriately sized crickets and dubia roaches.

name: Brazilian Black Tarantula
description: The Brazilian Black Tarantula (Grammostola pulchra) is arguably the most sought-after beginner tarantula in the world, prized for its stunning jet-black velvety appearance and incredibly calm temperament. These captive-bred juveniles are healthy and feeding well. Due to their very slow growth rate and limited captive production, these animals command a premium but are worth every penny.

name: Emperor Scorpion
description: The Emperor Scorpion (Pandinus imperator) is the classic pet scorpion — large, impressive, and with a venom that is generally quite mild, making it one of the safer scorpion species for responsible adult keepers. These captive-bred adults glow a brilliant blue-green under UV light and are feeding on crickets and roaches. Best housed individually in a humid tropical setup.

name: Coconut Fiber Substrate (10qt Brick)
description: A compressed coconut fiber brick that expands to 10 quarts of soft, moisture-retaining substrate. Ideal for tropical and humidity-loving species, it holds burrow structure well and naturally resists mold and odor. Safe for direct contact with animals and easy to replace during spot cleans.

name: Aspen Snake Bedding (24qt)
description: Premium shredded aspen wood bedding is the go-to dry substrate for North American colubrids and ball pythons. It holds burrow tunnels, is virtually dust-free, and makes it easy to spot-clean soiled areas without replacing the entire substrate. Avoid use with high-humidity setups or amphibians.

name: Organic Topsoil & Sand Mix (40lb)
description: A 60/40 blend of organic topsoil and play sand that mimics the arid and semi-arid environments of skinks, tegus, and hognose snakes. Holds burrow structure excellently while allowing proper drainage. Free of fertilizers, pesticides, and perlite — safe for all terrestrial reptiles.

name: Fine Orchid Bark Substrate (8qt)
description: Fine-grade fir bark chunks provide an excellent naturalistic substrate for arboreal species and tropical vivarium setups. It holds ambient humidity without becoming waterlogged, and its irregular texture enriches the environment for climbing animals. Works well in bioactive setups with live plants.

name: Aquatic Gravel Fine Black (10lb)
description: Smooth, fine-grade black aquatic gravel is the recommended bare-minimum substrate for axolotl tanks. The large enough particle size prevents accidental ingestion while providing a natural-looking floor and beneficial bacteria colony surface area. Rinse thoroughly before use.

name: UVB 5.0 Compact Fluorescent Bulb (13W)
description: This 5.0 UVB compact fluorescent bulb provides the low-to-moderate ultraviolet output recommended for forest and semi-tropical reptile species. Compatible with standard E26 dome fixtures, it supports natural D3 synthesis in lizards that require it without the intense output of desert UVB lamps.

name: UVB 10.0 T5 HO Bulb 24" (39W)
description: A high-output T5 HO 10.0 UVB tube bulb delivering the intense ultraviolet radiation required by desert and diurnal species such as tegus and skinks housed in large enclosures. Rated for 12 months of effective UVB output before replacement. Requires a compatible T5 HO strip fixture.

name: Basking Spot Bulb 100W
description: A focused incandescent basking bulb producing a tight, intense heat gradient ideal for thermoregulating reptiles. This 100W bulb achieves surface temperatures of 95–110°F at 6–8 inches, appropriate for tegus, skinks, and larger snakes during feeding stimulation. Pair with a thermometer to dial in exact basking surface temps.

name: Deep Dome Lamp Fixture (8.5")
description: A ceramic-socket deep dome reflector fixture rated for up to 150W incandescent or 160W halogen bulbs. The polished interior maximizes light and heat output directional focus. The spring-loaded clamp attaches to screen lids and enclosure lips securely. Compatible with basking bulbs, CHEs, and mercury vapor lamps.

name: Ceramic Heat Emitter 100W (CHE)
description: A ceramic heat emitter produces infrared heat without emitting any visible light, making it safe for 24/7 use without disrupting your animal's day/night cycle. Ideal as a primary heat source for snakes and a nighttime heat supplement for lizards. Screw into any ceramic-socket dome fixture — never a plastic one.

name: Under Tank Heater (UTH) Medium (8"x12")
description: This adhesive-backed under-tank heater provides belly heat spanning roughly one-third of a 20–40 gallon enclosure floor — the recommended coverage ratio for snakes and terrestrial amphibians. Always use with a thermostat to prevent overheating. Ideal for ball pythons, corn snakes, and pacman frogs.

name: Digital Thermostat (Pulse/Dimmer 1000W)
description: A professional-grade dual-mode digital thermostat compatible with both radiant heat panels and basking bulbs. The pulse mode is safe for CHEs and UTHs; the dimming mode prevents heat lamps from cycling on/off. An accurate, adjustable probe allows precise temperature control — an absolute must-have for any heated reptile enclosure.

name: Aquarium Chiller (1/10 HP)
description: A compact inline aquarium chiller capable of cooling up to 40 gallons of water. Essential for axolotl keepers in warmer climates, as axolotls require water temperatures between 60–68°F and suffer at temperatures above 72°F. Connects in-line with a canister or external filter for silent and efficient operation.

name: Small Cork Bark Round Hide
description: A natural cork bark tube section providing a secure, dark, and humidity-retaining hide for smaller reptiles and amphibians. Cork bark is naturally antimicrobial, lightweight, and aesthetically beautiful in naturalistic setups. This small size suits juvenile tegus, corn snakes, hognose snakes, blue-tongued skink hatchlings, and adult tree frogs.

name: Large Cork Bark Round Hide
description: An XL natural cork bark tube hide suited for adult blue-tongued skinks, adult ball pythons, corn snakes, and adult hognose snakes. Reptiles feel most secure in snug hides where their body contacts the walls on all sides — this hide provides that security while remaining visually stunning in a bioactive or naturalistic setup.

name: Magnetic Acrylic Arboreal Hide (Small)
description: A clear magnetic acrylic hide that attaches directly to the glass wall of your enclosure, allowing your arboreal gecko or tree frog to rest at an elevated position — just as they would cling to bark or a leaf in the wild. The magnetic backing holds securely on glass up to 8mm thick and is easy to remove for cleaning.

name: Humid Hide with Moss Cavity (Medium)
description: A cave-style humid microclimate hide with a recessed moss-filled cavity inside the chamber. Providing a humid hide is critical for ball pythons during shed, blue-tongued skinks in low-humidity environments, and hognose snakes that burrow to moult. Fill the moss cavity with dampened sphagnum moss and replace monthly.

name: Tarantula/Scorpion Starter Enclosure (32oz Deli Cup Vented)
description: A vented 32oz clear deli cup enclosure ideal for juvenile and sub-adult tarantulas and small scorpions. The cross-ventilation lid prevents moisture buildup while maintaining adequate humidity for tropical species. Includes a small cork hide and ventilation holes pre-drilled in the lid and sides.

name: Digital Hygrometer & Thermometer (Dual Probe)
description: A dual-probe digital thermometer and hygrometer that simultaneously monitors temperature and relative humidity at both the warm and cool ends of your enclosure. Features a min/max memory function to catch overnight temperature drops. An essential monitoring tool for every reptile and amphibian setup.

name: Infrared Temperature Gun
description: An instant-read infrared thermometer that measures surface temperatures at the press of a button — no contact needed. Provides accurate readings of basking spots, cool sides, and water surfaces in under a second. Far more reliable than analog dial thermometers for achieving the correct thermal gradient in your enclosure.

name: Aquarium Thermometer (Submersible Digital)
description: A submersible digital aquarium thermometer with a suction-cup mounting bracket for precise water temperature monitoring. Essential for axolotl keepers, as even a 2°F swing above 68°F can cause significant stress. The LCD display is clear and readable from outside the tank.

name: Reptile Water Dish (Medium Flat Rock Style)
description: A medium, heavy-gauge resin water dish styled to resemble a flat natural rock. Low-profile design is ideal for heavy-bodied species like blue-tongued skinks and ball pythons that like to soak. Weighted base prevents tipping, and the smooth interior is easy to sanitize. Sized at approximately 6" x 4".

name: Large Tegu & Skink Water Pan (10" x 14")
description: A large, shallow water pan purpose-built for tegus and adult blue-tongued skinks that require full-body soaking access. The low entry point makes it accessible even for short-legged species, and the food-safe resin construction is resistant to the cleaning agents used for reptile disinfection. Doubles as a feeding station for watery foods.

name: Aquarium Canister Filter (100 GPH)
description: A powerful external canister filter rated for up to 30 gallons, providing the mechanical, biological, and chemical filtration that axolotls require. Axolotls are messy eaters and produce heavy bioloads — a strong filter combined with weekly 20% water changes is essential for their long-term health. Includes filter media, intake, and output tubing.

name: Reptile Feeding Tongs (12" Stainless Steel)
description: Curved-tip stainless steel feeding tongs allow safe, precise prey item delivery without risking a feeding response bite to your fingers. The 12" length provides comfortable distance from ambush feeders like pacman frogs, hognose snakes, and ball pythons. Also useful for rearranging decor and removing shed skin.

name: Automatic Reptile Mister (2L Reservoir)
description: A programmable automatic misting system with a 2-liter reservoir and two adjustable nozzles. Maintains the elevated humidity levels required by tropical species — including crested geckos, gargoyle geckos, red-eyed tree frogs, and White's tree frogs — without daily manual spraying. Programmable for up to 4 misting cycles per day.

name: Sphagnum Moss (4qt Natural Dried)
description: Premium dried long-strand sphagnum moss is one of the most versatile materials in the reptile hobby. Use it to fill humid hides for shedding snakes and skinks, as a moisture-retaining top layer for pacman frogs, or as a planting medium in bioactive vivarium builds. Naturally antimicrobial and slow to decompose.

name: Artificial Hanging Vine & Leaf Decor (24")
description: A flexible 24" artificial hanging vine with attached silk leaves, suitable for arboreal vivarium decoration and enrichment. Provides additional climbing surface area and resting perches for tree frogs and geckos, and adds visual cover that reduces stress in display animals. Easy to bend into shape and clean with reptile-safe disinfectant.

name: Reptile Calcium Powder with D3 (3oz)
description: A finely milled calcium carbonate powder with added vitamin D3 for reptiles and amphibians housed under insufficient UVB lighting. Dust feeder insects lightly before each feeding to prevent metabolic bone disease — a common and preventable calcium deficiency disorder. Suitable for lizards, frogs, salamanders, and juvenile tegus.

name: Reptile Multivitamin Powder (2oz)
description: A comprehensive reptile multivitamin supplement containing vitamin A, E, B-complex, and trace minerals to complement a varied feeder insect and whole-prey diet. Use once or twice weekly in rotation with calcium powder to ensure full micronutrient coverage. Suitable for all insectivorous and omnivorous reptiles and amphibians.

name: Small Dubia Roaches (1/4") - 50 Count
description: Dubia roaches are widely regarded as the superior feeder insect in the reptile hobby. With a soft exoskeleton, high protein content (~36% protein dry weight), and low chitin ratio compared to crickets, they are ideal for daily feeding of juvenile lizards, geckos, skinks, and amphibians. These 1/4" nymphs are the perfect size for hatchlings and juveniles. Dubia roaches are slow, odorless, and cannot climb smooth surfaces — making escapes nearly impossible.

name: Large Dubia Roaches (3/4"-1") - 25 Count
description: These large adult and sub-adult Dubia roaches are the ideal staple feeder for adult blue-tongued skinks, tegus, adult pacman frogs, and large tarantulas. Their thick, meaty bodies deliver excellent caloric value with a favorable calcium-to-phosphorus ratio. Gut-load with fresh vegetables 24 hours before feeding for maximum nutritional transfer to your animal.

name: Small Crickets (1/4"-1/2") - 100 Count
description: Live small crickets are a versatile, widely accepted feeder insect for a huge range of reptiles and amphibians. Their natural movement triggers strong feeding responses in even finicky eaters. This size is appropriate for juvenile crested geckos, gargoyle geckos, tree frogs, juvenile skinks, and small tarantulas. Always gut-load 24–48 hours before use and dust with calcium/vitamin powder immediately before feeding.

name: Large Crickets (3/4"-1") - 100 Count
description: Full-grown adult crickets are a staple feeder for larger insectivores and omnivores. Their substantial size and vigorous movement make them excellent prey for adult blue-tongued skinks, tegus, pacman frogs, White's tree frogs, and emperor scorpions. Remove any uneaten crickets from the enclosure within a few hours as they may stress or bite resting animals.

name: Frozen Pinky Mice - 10 Pack
description: Frozen pinkies are newborn mice that have been humanely frozen at peak nutritional value. They are the recommended first prey item for juvenile corn snakes, hognose snakes, and young ball pythons. Always thaw completely in warm water before offering — never microwave. Frozen-thawed prey is safer for your snake than live feeding as it eliminates the risk of rodent bites.

name: Frozen Adult Mice - 10 Pack
description: Frozen adult mice are a complete, nutritionally balanced meal for a wide variety of snakes and large lizards. Suitable for adult corn snakes, adult hognose snakes, sub-adult ball pythons, and large skinks. Each mouse is individually packaged to allow easy single-portion thawing. Thaw in warm water for 20–30 minutes and test internal temperature before offering.

name: Frozen Jumbo Rats - 5 Pack
description: Frozen jumbo rats are the appropriate prey size for large adult ball pythons, adult tegus, and large constrictors. A single jumbo rat provides a complete, appropriately sized meal with an ideal surface area-to-weight ratio for adult snakes in the 1,000–1,500g+ range. Individually vacuum-sealed to preserve freshness and prevent freezer burn.

name: Waxworms - 50 Count
description: Waxworms are the high-fat treat feeder of the reptile world — comparable to candy for your animal. Their soft bodies and irresistible smell make them excellent for enticing picky eaters or recovering animals that have stopped feeding. Use sparingly as a supplement, no more than once a week, for geckos, small lizards, and tree frogs. Not suitable as a staple feeder due to high fat content.

name: Black Soldier Fly Larvae (BSFL) - 250 Count
description: Black Soldier Fly Larvae, also sold under the brand name NutriGrubs, are a nutritional powerhouse with a naturally balanced calcium-to-phosphorus ratio of approximately 1.5:1 — making them one of the few feeder insects that don't require additional calcium dusting. They are soft-bodied, slow-moving, and accepted readily by picky geckos, skinks, and tree frogs. Best fed in a small bowl to prevent burrowing into substrate.

name: Repashy Crested Gecko MRP (6oz)
description: Repashy Crested Gecko Meal Replacement Powder is the gold-standard complete diet for crested geckos and gargoyle geckos — developed in collaboration with leading herpetologists to meet all macro and micronutrient requirements. Simply mix 1 part powder with 2 parts water to create a ready-to-eat gel diet. Offer fresh every 24–48 hours. Many geckos thrive on this diet alone, though supplemental insect feeding is always encouraged for enrichment.

name: 20 Gallon Long Glass Terrarium (30"x12"x12")
description: The 20-gallon long is the classic starter enclosure for juvenile snakes and small terrestrial reptiles. Its elongated footprint provides a better warm-to-cool temperature gradient than a standard 20-gallon high. Features a hinged screen top with two locking clips to prevent escape-artist colubrids from pushing out. Compatible with all standard under-tank heaters and overhead lighting fixtures. Ideal as a grow-out enclosure for juvenile corn snakes, hognose snakes, and young ball pythons.

name: 40 Gallon Breeder Glass Terrarium (36"x18"x18")
description: The 40-gallon breeder is the most popular adult enclosure for ball pythons, corn snakes, and adult hognose snakes. Its wide 18" depth allows for a proper thermal gradient and enrichment items side by side. The full-screen top provides excellent ventilation and supports overhead UVB and basking lighting. A workhorse enclosure suitable for most medium-bodied snakes and larger terrestrial lizards.

name: PVC Reptile Enclosure 4'x2'x2' (Front-Opening)
description: A professional-grade front-opening PVC enclosure offering superior insulation and humidity retention compared to glass. The 4'x2'x2' footprint is the gold-standard adult size for ball pythons, large corn snakes, and adult blue-tongued skinks. Dual sliding front doors with key locks, two cable pass-through ports, and a reinforced ABS plastic bottom pan make this an ideal long-term home. Available in black or white.

name: PVC Reptile Enclosure 6'x3'x2' (Tegu & Monitor)
description: An extra-large front-opening PVC enclosure built to house adult tegus, large monitors, and other big lizards that need room to roam. The 6'x3'x2' interior provides ample space for deep substrate burrowing, multiple hides, a full-body water dish, and a proper basking zone. Reinforced aluminum frame, lockable sliding doors, and four cable ports make this a premium, permanent housing solution for large lizards.

name: Tall Arboreal Vivarium Kit 18"x18"x36"
description: A purpose-built tall glass arboreal enclosure designed for climbing species. The extra height — 36 inches — provides vertical space for crested geckos, gargoyle geckos, and tree frogs to climb, perch, and leap between branches. Features dual front-opening doors for easy access, a bottom waterproof tray for bioactive substrate, a screen top panel for ventilation, and foam background ports for live-plant setups.

name: Bioactive Starter Vivarium Kit 12"x12"x18"
description: A compact front-opening glass nano vivarium kit designed for small arboreal geckos and tree frogs in a bioactive setup. Includes a false bottom drainage layer, mesh divider, 2qt coconut fiber substrate, a background foam panel, and two magnetic ledge hides. Everything needed to start a simple bioactive vivarium right out of the box. Best suited for a single crested gecko, gargoyle gecko, or a pair of small tree frogs.

name: 20 Gallon Aquarium with Lid (24"x12"x16")
description: A standard 20-gallon glass aquarium suited for axolotl setups. The tall profile allows for a minimum 8-inch water depth recommended for axolotls, and the clear glass provides excellent viewing. Includes a hinged lid to prevent any escape attempts and reduce evaporation. Pair with a canister filter, aquarium chiller, and fine-grade substrate for a complete axolotl habitat.

name: Pacman Frog Habitat Kit (12"x12"x12")
description: A compact, purpose-designed enclosure kit for pacman frogs and other sedentary terrestrial amphibians. Includes a 12"x12"x12" glass enclosure with front-hinged door, 2qt coconut fiber substrate, a small shallow water dish, and a feeding ledge. Pacman frogs only need a small footprint — they sit and wait for prey — making this kit perfectly sized without excess unused space that can cause feeding problems.

name: Acrylic Tarantula & Scorpion Enclosure (12"x8"x10")
description: A crystal-clear acrylic enclosure with cross-ventilation side panels and a secure sliding top lid designed specifically for terrestrial tarantulas and emperor scorpions. The front-facing viewing panel provides an unobstructed display, and the low profile suits terrestrial species that don't climb. Substrate depth of up to 5 inches supports natural burrowing behavior in Chaco golden knees and Brazilian blacks.

name: Blue-Tongued Skink PVC Enclosure 4'x2'x18" (Low Profile)
description: A low-profile front-opening PVC enclosure optimized for blue-tongued skinks, which are terrestrial and rarely climb but require a wide footprint for thermoregulation and burrowing. The reduced height concentrates heat output from overhead basking bulbs more efficiently at substrate level. Includes two sliding front doors, two cable ports, a removable divider for housing juveniles in half the space, and a white interior finish to maximize light reflectivity.
